options.name: day_of_the_month_to_run
options.displayName: Day Of The Month To Run
options.description: Specifies From which Day of the month backup should start.

options.name: days_of_the_week_to_run
options.displayName: Days Of The Week To Run
options.description: Specifies Day of the week when backup has been scheduled. 0-Sunday, 1-Monday and so on. The accepted value range is between C(0) and C(6).

options.name: encryption_password
options.description: Encryption password for the backup to be created. Password should be minimum of 8 characters.

options.name: frequency
options.description: Ensured that backup is scheduled Monthly, Weekly or Daily. The accepted value is Monthly, Weekly, Daily.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the backup file to be created while Scheduling a Backup. Actual File Name is auto-generated in the case of Instant Backup.

options.name: schedule
options.description: Specifies whether backup is to be scheduled or not.

options.name: scheduled
options.description: When C(True), ensures that that scheduled backup is to be delete. When C(False), ensures that that Instant backup is to be delete. Scheduled Parameter is required when state is absent.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(backup), ensures the backup is file is created instantly. When C(scheduled_backup), ensures the backup is file is scheduled. When C(restore), ensures the target BIG-IP Next instance is restored from the given backup filename. When C(absent), ensures the backup file is removed.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds to wait for the backup or restore operation to complete. The accepted value range is between C(150) and C(3600) seconds.
